title: Two shadows of a single black hole: Vacuum birefringence phenomena within Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics
summary: One of the main features of nonlinear electrodynamics is the existence of an effective geometry that describes the geodesic motion of photons. A detailed analysis of the properties of effective geometry is of utmost importance for a better understanding of nonlinear electrodynamics theories and their possible imprints on physics, especially in the context of black holes.
